main_text.head: AD LECTOREM.
main_text.p: ODen istam Ionicam, cùm ante- hac saltem tentandi generis, quo Horatius semel usus, causâ fecissem; postea incideram in Scaligerum, qui autumat, eo olim agitatos fuisse adulteros, meretrices, proditores, lenones, ebrios: gavisus equidem & gratulatus mihi fui, quòd ipsa Nemesis, ut auguror, τὸ πεῖτον mihi suggesserit. Nam hoc profecto genus Balatronum dicam an Latronum, omninò inter illud est connumerandum & tandum ad laqueos, si essent Archilochi aut saltem Archi.

page.notes: The first letter O is a large decorated initial, joined to "Den" as printed as "ODen" (read as O + Den). The Greek phrase "τὸ πεῖτον" is partly illegible in the scan; reading is doubtful. The word "incideram" is read as printed "incideram"; the scan shows "inciderem" with a faint letter, so it is marked as uncertain. The signature line "Benedictus de Claromonte," is set in italic/black-letter type.
